visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot inside a moving vehicle where a male with glasses in a grey sweater is driving while a female with sunglasses and a grey cardigan is filming a selfie video, both appear joyful. (2) The scene cuts to the pair walking through a traditional Japanese-style park with wooden buildings and a water wheel; the man holds a small object while the woman gestures towards the camera. (3) A shot from behind shows the woman leaning on a wooden fence overlooking a vast lake under a blue sky with white clouds, pointing towards a distant mountain partially obscured by clouds. (4) The man is then seen crouching in a vibrant field of red tulips, smiling broadly as he interacts with the flowers. (5) Several white swans are shown swimming on the lake surface with mountains in the background. (6) The pair is shown on a wooden dock feeding the swans from small cups; the man reacts with a startled laugh as a swan nips at his hand. (7) The woman walks towards a wooden sign marking 'World Heritage Sacred Place 1' and then ascends stone steps through a series of red torii gates in a lush forest. (8) Close-up shots follow, showing a crystal-clear pond with small fish swimming over a stony bottom and vibrant green foliage surrounding the area. (9) The pair is seen in a crowded street sharing a green dango snack, with the woman taking a bite. (10) A hand holds up a document translated into Japanese while the man stands in the background; then, a screen recording of a mobile app interface titled 'Gogoout' is displayed, showing various car rental options and maps of Japan. (11) The woman is shown waving next to a white compact car in an urban street, followed by the man driving that same car. (12) The final scene shows a close-up of beef being cooked in a sukiyaki pot and the woman smiling while holding chopsticks, transitioning to a promotional graphic for the app.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal female voice speaking excitedly in Traditional Chinese, overlaid with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic pop BGM featuring a steady drum beat and guitar strumming. (2) A transition whoosh SFX marks a shift as the woman describes the lake; the vocal pitch remains high and energetic. (3) During the swan feeding, the male voice enters with a loud, surprised 'Ah!' and laughter, accompanied by a 'Pop' cartoon SFX as he claims to be bitten. (4) The woman's tone shifts to a more informative, narrative style as she explains the pond and the car rental process, while the BGM maintains a consistent mid-tempo pulse. (5) In the final segment, the vocals take on a promotional, persuasive tone, clearly enunciating the benefits of the app, ending with a cheerful sign-off and the BGM fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Experience -> Informative -> Promotion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel vlog showcasing a road trip around Mt. Fuji to promote the 'Gogoout' car rental application. It uses beautiful scenic shots and personal experiences to demonstrate the convenience and cost-effectiveness of renting a car for international travel.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features a dedicated segment explaining how to use the Gogoout app, showing its UI, and listing its benefits and current promotions.
